projects.title: Ciphermaniac
projects.description: To show my local league players what cards are frequently used in the Pokémon card game, I created this tool tracking the usage of cards in major tournaments. Now serves thousands of daily users.

projects.title: Ciphermaniac Events
projects.description: I built browser-based tournament tools for registration, Swiss pairings, decklists, standings, and top cut.

projects.title: Balatro3DS
projects.description: A port of one of my favorite video games to the Nintendo 3DS utilizing a port of its engine to the console. Forked from a project that started the work, but completed referencing the game's original code.

projects.title: FilmScraper
projects.description: Wanting a more user-friendly view of movies showing in town, I created a minimal frontend utilizing data from Fandango.

projects.title: De-Guidebooked San Japan Guide
projects.description: I decompiled the San Japan Android app and extracted the convention's schedule to make it freely available without an account. Additionally, I used OCR to make the app's maps smarter, and added inter-linking between listings, guests, and locations.

projects.title: Bexar County Voting Data
projects.description: Dissatisfied with the County's lack of transparency, I created a site to visualize historical and present Bexar County voting data.

projects.title: MatchaTab
projects.description: Inspired by Tabliss, a deeply customizable and modular new tab page to meet my needs. Built for Firefox browsers (my preference).

projects.title: BrahDB
projects.description: Processed data visualization from YouTube's finest fast food reviewer, ReportOfTheWeek, with data scraped, collected, and transformed from subtitles using Python.

projects.title: Favorite Film Friend Finder
projects.description: Inspired by a Tweet, a simple tool for finding Letterboxd users with your same top four favorite films.

projects.title: Movie Map
projects.description: Visualizing the connections between people's four favorite movies on Letterboxd.

clients.title: SAY Sí
clients.description: I redesigned the WordPress site around a lighter theme, upgraded PHP from 5.3 to 8.4, and built a bespoke plugin so staff could manage the site more easily.

clients.title: United Professional Organizers
clients.description: I redesigned the WordPress site and built Patreon-linked tools for members-only content, along with other internal tools.

clients.title: Stonewall Action
clients.description: I designed the WordPress site as part of a broader engagement that included design consulting and photography.

clients.title: Bexar County Democratic Party
clients.description: I led the move from Wix to WordPress and the full redesign, working with committees, county chairs, and party staff.

clients.title: Aust Surgical Society
clients.description: I rebuilt the ASP.NET site as a static website and have maintained the site since 2021.

clients.title: Cinappses
clients.description: I designed an Astro site with Sveltia CMS and no ongoing hosting bill for the artist. I also built a guestbook where visitors can write or draw, with drawings saved in a Cloudflare D1 database.

clients.title: Combat Power Gaming
clients.description: I built internal store-credit and event-management tools. The credit system tracks balances for hundreds of players, representing thousands of dollars in store-credit liability; the store also uses Ciphermaniac Events.

clients.title: Ruby City
clients.description: I built visitor-services training tools that make the collection easier for the team to explore. I also advised on proposed website changes.
